# NFL Daily — 2026-07-28 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 07/27: Buccaneers DT Vita Vea requested a trade after stalled contract extension talks. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49465466/two-pro-bowl-dt-vita-vea-requests-trade-buccaneers) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2081866263043743821)
- 07/28: Three-time Pro Bowl S Jamal Adams officially signed with the Vikings. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49466043/three-pro-bowler-jamal-adams-join-minnesota-vikings) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2082116511888498972)
- 07/28: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan suffered a broken nose, ribs, hand and a concussion — and nearly lost an eye — in his car crash; he'll start camp in a limited role. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/kyle-shanahan-car-accident-injuries-49ers-training-camp/) — also [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49470176/kyle-shanahan-nearly-lost-eye-car-crash-says-friend-chris-simms)
- 07/28: Buccaneers and QB Baker Mayfield have made no real progress on a new contract as he reports to camp. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49469946/sources-no-real-progress-mayfield-buccaneers-contract-talks)
- 07/27: Wife of Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy was shot at the couple's Virginia home; their son was arrested and charged. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49462234/sources-wife-chiefs-eric-bieniemy-shot-couple-home) — also [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/chiefs-oc-eric-bieniemy-wife-shot/)
- 07/28: Commanders fired TE coach Ben Steele two days before camp, following a DWI arrest. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49462862/commanders-fire-te-coach-ben-steele-following-dwi-charge)
- 07/28: Steelers QB Aaron Rodgers says there's "zero debate" — 2026 will be his final NFL season. [NFL.com](https://www.nfl.com/news/steelers-aaron-rodgers-says-zero-debate-2026-will-be-final-season-in-nfl)
